description: RV-P2.4.T6 — the H1′ re-gate pair, end to end over gRPC. Turn 1 resolves the typo'd question and must NOT bind the code: `5010O1` is not in the account index, so the honest answer is a G4_METHOD_MISS. Turn 2 is an LLM rung's hypothesis coming back through `resolve.gate:v1` — the correction `5010O1`→`501001` on účet.kód — which the core turns into a lexicon lookup and puts through the SAME evidence-class gate as any other candidate. It survives, the binding appears carrying its proposing rung, and the gap closes. The pair is the whole re-gate contract: a rung may propose, only the gate may bind (RV-7).
